To find stationary points, first differentiate f(x) to get f'(x). Then set f'(x)=0 and solve for x. These x-values give potential stationary points. Finally, evaluate f(x) at these points to determine their coordinates and use the second derivative test or analyze the sign changes of f'(x) to classify them as minima, maxima, or saddle points.
